title: Tetrameric Lanthanide Neopentoxide Complexes with Agostic Ln···H–C Interactions: X-ray Crystal Structures of Ln4(OCH2-t-Bu)12 (Ln = La, Nd)

material_class.structural_family: square Ln4 alkoxide tetramer with eight μ2-OR and four terminal OR ligands

synthesis.procedure: Reaction of La[N(SiMe3)2]3 with 3 equiv of dry neopentanol in hexane at 25 °C, followed by cooling to −40 °C, yields colorless crystals of [La(OCH2-t-Bu)3]4 (1). The compounds are oxygen- and moisture-sensitive and soluble in noncoordinating hydrocarbon solvents. Single crystals of 1 were grown at −40 °C from concentrated hexane solution.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction under oxygen- and moisture-sensitive conditions
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: cooling the hexane reaction mixture to −40 °C; single crystals from concentrated hexane at −40 °C

properties.summary: Nujol-mull IR of 1 shows alkoxide ligation plus a low ν(C–H) at 2688 cm−1, assigned to agostic La···H–C interactions in the solid state; benzene-solution IR shows a similar band at 2680 cm−1, indicating the agostic interaction is retained in solution.

source_locations.location: title and structural discussion of Ln4(OCH2-t-Bu)12

material_class.structural_family: square Ln4 alkoxide tetramer with eight μ2-OR, four terminal OR ligands, and lattice toluene

synthesis.procedure: Reaction of Nd[N(SiMe3)2]3 with 3 equiv of dry neopentanol in hexane at 25 °C, followed by cooling to −40 °C, yields pale blue crystals of [Nd(OCH2-t-Bu)3]4 (2). The compounds are oxygen- and moisture-sensitive and soluble in noncoordinating hydrocarbon solvents. Single crystals of 2 were grown at −40 °C from concentrated toluene-d8 solution; the crystal lattice contains four toluene molecules per tetramer.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction under oxygen- and moisture-sensitive conditions
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: cooling the hexane reaction mixture to −40 °C; single crystals from concentrated toluene-d8 at −40 °C

properties.summary: Nujol-mull IR of 2 shows alkoxide ligation plus a low ν(C–H) at 2692 cm−1, assigned to agostic Nd···H–C interactions in the solid state; benzene-solution IR shows a similar band at 2686 cm−1. Paramagnetism of 2 is noted only as hindering NMR interpretation and is not quantified magnetically.

source_locations.location: structural discussion noting four toluene molecules per tetramer in the lattice of 2
